Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added a Welcome screen on startup: pick DJ for your deck, or Listener for a quick Join a Show screen
Kicked/disconnected listeners now return to Join a Show instead of the full Deck
Minimize no longer does anything while in Settings
